legal.headline: Kerala High Court refuses to stay State's reconstitution of Waqf Board
legal.hook: Kerala High Court refuses to stay State's reconstitution of Waqf Board
legal.summary: The Kerala High Court has declined to grant a stay on the State Government's reconstitution of the Kerala Waqf Board, which was previously challenged by the All India Waqf Board and other petitioners. The court's decision came during a hearing on a petition filed by the All India Waqf Board, which argued that the reconstitution was done without proper consultation and violated the provisions of the Waqf Act, 1995. The State Government had reconstituted the Board to include new members, which the petitioners claimed undermined the existing governance structure. The court noted that the petitioners did not demonstrate any irreparable harm that would warrant a stay. The matter will continue to be heard in due course, with the next hearing scheduled for a later date.
